## Zendesk Ticket Dashboard
Hourly fetch of Zendesk tickets, calculates metrics (open/pending/resolved), logs to Sheets dashboard, and alerts Slack on SLA breaches.

**Setup:**
1. Replace YOUR_SUBDOMAIN in the Zendesk API URL
2. Set HTTP Basic Auth (email/token:api_token)
3. Connect Google Sheets for dashboard data
4. Set Slack channel for SLA breach alerts
5. Adjust SLA threshold in Code node (default: 24 hours)
